parameters.content:
## Daily Jobs Digest, fresh openings in your niche

Every morning this checks for jobs posted in the last 24 hours that match your search, scores each one against what you actually care about, and delivers them two ways: strong matches arrive as an instant alert so you can apply first, everything else arrives as one clean digest.

### Setup, about 4 minutes

1. **Apify token.** Create a free account at apify.com, open Settings, then API & Integrations, and copy your Personal API token. Add it to the *Fetch Fresh Jobs from Hirebase* node as a Bearer Auth credential.
2. **Search Settings.** Open that node and fill in your keywords, locations and preferences. Nothing else needs editing.
3. **Connect Slack, Gmail and Google Sheets** on the output nodes, then pick your channel and spreadsheet.
4. **Google Sheet.** Put this header row in row 1: Date Found, Job Title, Company, Location, Work Type, Salary, Score, Why It Matched, Apply Link
5. Activate the workflow.

### Good to know

- Jobs are remembered between runs, so the same posting never reaches you twice. That is what makes it safe to raise the schedule to hourly.
- On days with no new matches, nothing is sent.
- The Hirebase jobs feed on Apify is pay per result at $3 per 1,000 jobs, billed to your own Apify account.

## 1. Everything you configure lives here

Open **Search Settings** and edit the values. The next node turns them into a valid API request, so you never touch JSON.

- **keywords / jobTitles**: comma separated, at least one is required
- **locations**: separate with semicolons
- **locationTypes**: Remote, Hybrid, In-Person
- **jobTypes**: Full Time, Part Time, Contract, Internship
- **experienceLevels**: Entry, Junior, Mid, Senior, Executive
- **visaSponsorship**: any, yes or no
- **priorityScore**: jobs scoring this high get an instant alert

## 2. Scoring and memory

**Score and Rank Jobs** gives every posting a score: exact title match, keyword hits, salary at or above target, remote, visa sponsorship. The reason is stored next to each job.

**Skip Jobs Already Sent** remembers every job id from previous runs, so repeat postings never reach you twice. This is what makes it safe to run more often than once a day.

If the job feed is unreachable, the error branch posts a failure notice to Slack instead of failing silently.

## 3. Where matches go

**Strong match**: an instant Slack alert, one per job.

**Normal match**: batched into a single digest sent to Slack and email.

**Weak match**: logged to the sheet only, no notification.

Every new job, whatever its score, is appended to your Google Sheet so you build a searchable history of the market in your niche.
